title: Studying hard, dorm life and giving up piano
summary: He reflects that missing out on land made him study; describes dormitory routine and how a girlfriend caused him to miss piano lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Because I think it made me study hard. Because I studied hard when I was in school... Well, going to school, we had a dormitory and we had ROTC. So we got the drill and we studied in... See, in the dormitory you're not doin' anything but sleep and eat, and get up and have breakfast, and then you had dinner and lunch...and you had dinner... You didn't have to worry about nothin'! You didn't have to do nothin' but study. And we had study periods during the time of administration, because we went from 9 to 4. So we didn't take no... Classes was 9, 10, 11, and off for lunch from 12 to 1, and then from 1 to 2, and 2 to 3, and 3 to 4... You didn't have to take all that...

The worst thing I messed up on, I started taking piano, but I didn't... The time period for studying piano was the time I used to see one of my girlfriends. And that's what messed me up. I didn't get to learn that piano. Because I... We had a good piano teacher, too. And if I had just studied, I could have learned piano. I tried to learn later on in life. The guy gave up. I gave up myself.
You gave up on the teacher.
Now, I know the keyboard. But come to playing it, I just can't play it.
Because you know all the guys in the band that played a little piano...
